title: Exploring Automated Vulnerability Identification in JavaScript Code Using Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.13816v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: JavaScript powers approximately 98.8% of all websites, making vulnerabilities in its code a significant security risk, yet existing detection approaches such as Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools often fail to identify many real-world vulnerabilities when applied to isolated code snippets. This paper presents an empirical study of Large Language Model (LLM)-based vulnerability identification for JavaScript programs, evaluating three LLM families (Gemini 1.5 Flash, GPT-4o Mini, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B) across multiple prompting strategies (zero-shot, chain-of-thought, few-shot) and fine-tuning approaches on a dataset of 1,125 JavaScript code snippets spanning five Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) categories: Injection (CWE-74), OS Command Injection (CWE-78), Cross-Site Scripting (CWE-79), SQL Injection (CWE-89), and Uncontrolled Resource Consumption (CWE-400). translated_title: 探索使用大型语言模型自动识别JavaScript代码中的漏洞
translated_abstract: JavaScript驱动着大约98.8%的网站，使其代码中的漏洞成为重大安全风险，然而现有的检测方法（如静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具）在应用于孤立代码片段时往往无法识别许多真实世界中的漏洞。本文对基于大型语言模型（LLM）的JavaScript程序漏洞识别进行了一项实证研究，在一个包含1,125个JavaScript代码片段的数据集上评估了三个LLM系列（Gemini 1.5 Flash、GPT-4o Mini、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B），涵盖多种提示策略（零样本、思维链、少样本）和微调方法，该数据集跨越五个通用缺陷枚举（CWE）类别：注入（CWE-74）、操作系统命令注入（CWE-78）、跨站脚本（CWE-79）、SQL注入（CWE-89）以及不受控制的资源消耗（CWE-400）。我们的实验表明，LLM显著优于……
tldr: 该论文通过在五种CWE漏洞类别的1,125个JavaScript代码片段上评估三个大型语言模型系列的多种提示策略和微调方法，实证证明了LLM在JavaScript漏洞识别方面显著优于传统SAST工具。
en_tdlr: This empirical study evaluates three LLM families across multiple prompting strategies and fine-tuning approaches for identifying JavaScript vulnerabilities across five CWE categories, demonstrating that LLMs substantially outperform traditional SAST tools.
